resources.string: Spot Voice uses this accessibility service only inside the Claude or ChatGPT app: after the wake word it taps the voice-mode button, mutes the assistant\'s microphone while the assistant speaks (the Echo Spot has no echo cancellation), reads the on-screen transcript to notice a spoken goodbye such as \"thank you Claude\", presses \"End\" when the conversation is over and notices when you leave the app (then Spot Voice listens again). Nothing is sent anywhere and nothing is tapped in other apps; for troubleshooting only on-screen labels end up in the local system log (logcat).
